description: T-5123 (T-2851's plain-range shapes; the column twin of plain-range-delete-row-last): with no table, does a plain range shrink when delete_column deletes its last column (F)? S!C4:F4 hold 1,2,4,8 and S!H4 16; sheet F holds A1 =SUM(S!C4:F4), A2 FORMULATEXT(A1), A3 =SUM(S!$C$4:$F$4), A4 FORMULATEXT(A3), A5 =SUM(S!C4:C4) (one column), A6 FORMULATEXT(A5), A7 =SUM(S!F4:H4), A8 FORMULATEXT(A7).
